narrative.northStar: 清晰的白蓝云服务界面
narrative.overview:
This is an implementation record of the current Chinese cloud homepage sample. White and ice-blue surfaces, cobalt actions, dark blue typography, thin borders, and restrained rounded cards preserve the reference's approachable corporate cloud character. The provisional 云序 / YUNXU identity is a fictional demonstration brand.

The system keeps product comparison compact and makes configuration changes visible. A glass-cloud hero image supplies the main decorative focal point; product information and subsequent sections use structured layouts and outline icons. Source of truth: `app/globals.css`, `app/page.tsx`, `components/ProductCatalog.tsx`, and `components/product-catalog.css`. This document records code, not a browser verification result.
keyCharacteristics: White and pale-blue fields with one dominant cobalt accent.
Locally served Chinese sans-serif typography and tabular price numerals.
Thin borders, modest radii, and limited ambient shadows.
Visible selected states and an inline, copyable configuration preview.
dos: Do reuse the implemented cobalt, dark text, pale backgrounds, and thin border language.
Do keep demonstration status visible wherever plans, prices, and region coverage appear.
Do preserve keyboard focus, state semantics, live copy feedback, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do maintain readable configuration data and both annual total and monthly equivalent in annual mode.
donts: Don't present fictional prices, regions, or resources as a live commercial service.
Don't add customer logos, certifications, SLA figures, or customer counts without evidence.
Don't replace the chosen white/blue corporate language with an unrelated identity.
Don't infer text-input or checkout patterns from controls that are not implemented.
